original_value: ASUS Phoenix GeForce GTX 1050 Ti comes equipped with a dual ball-bearing fan for a 2X longer card lifespan and exclusive Auto-Extreme Technology with Super Alloy Power II components for superior stability. ASUS Phoenix GeForce GTX 1050 Ti also has GPU Tweak II with XSplit Gamecaster that provides intuitive performance tweaking and real-time streaming.Without the problem of oil drying common in sleeve-bearing fans, the dual-ball bearing fan on ASUS Phoenix GeForce GTX 1050 Ti lasts 2X longer. With reduced friction, it also runs smoother, further improving card lifespan and cooling efficiency.

result.paraphrase: ASUS Phoenix GeForce GTX 1050 Ti includes a dual ball-bearing fan that delivers a 2X longer card lifespan, along with exclusive Auto-Extreme Technology and Super Alloy Power II components for enhanced stability. It also features GPU Tweak II with XSplit Gamecaster for easy performance tuning and real-time streaming. Unlike sleeve-bearing fans, the dual-ball bearing fan avoids oil-drying issues, lasts 2X longer, and, thanks to lower friction, operates more smoothly to further boost card lifespan and cooling efficiency.
